evals.prompt: Write tests for our new money module in src/money_module.py.
evals.expected_output: Adds property tests for sum preservation and round trips across 0-, 2- and 3-decimal currencies, frozen vectors, explicit rounding cases, and a mutation run.
expectations: Includes property tests with a fixed seed for allocation sum preservation and parse/format round trips
Includes frozen vectors for every public function returning an amount
Includes rounding cases where HALF_UP and HALF_EVEN differ
Covers 0- and 3-decimal currencies and negative amounts
Mentions running a mutation testing tool and reporting the kill rate

evals.prompt: Coverage is 95% on the payments module (src/coverage_report.txt, tests in src/test_payments_weak.py). Is that enough?
evals.expected_output: Says coverage does not measure assertion quality; proposes mutation kill rate, invariant tests, idempotency and timeout tests and date edge cases.
expectations: States that line coverage does not prove the tests catch wrong amounts, and points at the weak assertions in the file
Proposes a mutation testing run and a kill-rate target
Lists missing test classes: invariants, idempotency and timeout, date edges
Asks which test would fail on a lost cent or a double charge

evals.prompt: Our payment tests (src/test_stripe_live.py) are flaky because they hit the Stripe sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Replaces live sandbox calls in unit tests with recorded fixtures, keeps a scheduled contract test against the sandbox, uses a fake processor for timeouts, and injects the clock.
expectations: Unit and integration tests replay recorded fixtures instead of calling the sandbox
A scheduled contract test refreshes the recordings and fails on staleness
A fake processor can time out and fail on command for idempotency tests
The wall clock is injected rather than read

evals.prompt: Delete src/test_allocation_flaky.py; it fails randomly in CI.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the test, fixes the nondeterminism (seeded RNG, valid ratio generation) and checks whether the random failures were a real bug in allocate (all-zero ratios), instead of deleting a property test.
expectations: Does not delete the property test
Seeds the random generator and generates valid inputs deterministically
Investigates the failure cause and finds the all-zero ratios case (division by zero) as a real defect or an invalid input to reject
Keeps sum preservation as the asserted property

evals.prompt: Review src/test_interest_review.py for our interest module.
evals.expected_output: Finds the tautology (expected computed by the code under test), the wall clock, the approximate money assertion, and the missing residual and leap-year cases, and rewrites them as vectors.
expectations: Identifies that test_price_total compares the function with itself
Identifies the wall clock and the approximate assertion on money
Replaces them with fixed-date vectors and exact integer assertions, including the sum-of-principal invariant
Adds a leap-year or month-end case

evals.prompt: Set up mutation testing for src/money_module.py and tell me the number.
evals.expected_output: Configures a mutation tool, explains how to run it, reports kill rate over decided mutants (errors and timeouts excluded), sets a threshold, and puts the number in the pull request.
expectations: Configures mutmut, cosmic-ray or an equivalent for the module
Defines the kill rate over killed plus survived mutants, excluding errors and timeouts
Sets a threshold (around 80%) and reports the number in the pull request
Lists surviving mutants as missing assertions to add

evals.prompt: Our idempotency tests (src/test_idempotency_happy.py) only cover the happy path. Add the rest, against src/payments.py.
evals.expected_output: Adds timeout-then-success, concurrent duplicate, same key different payload, crash between persist and call, and 4xx not retried, using a fake processor.
expectations: Adds a test where the processor times out after charging and a same-key retry yields one charge
Adds a test for two concurrent requests with the same key producing one charge
Adds a test for same key with a different payload being refused
Adds a test that a 4xx is not retried and a 5xx is retried with a cap
Uses a fake processor scripted per test
